_doc: Generic evidence items for photo-based collapse screening. Each item: theme, description, what to look for, and likelihood terms.
flag:     {flag, p:[p_if_true, p_if_false]}  flags = causes A,M,X,D,F + cap + modes base, blast, top, lat, base_only
modes:    {p:{mode: value}} multiplied for every collapse mode that occurred
Values are expert-elicited (P(observation | state)). They are deliberately moderate: photos are indirect evidence.
value: 'high' items are the ones worth asking for when missing (listed as data gaps in the report).
contradicted_by: items that cannot both be true; a contradicted item is not listed as a data gap.

PANCAKE_IN_FOOTPRINT.desc: Slabs stacked flat (pancake) within or next to the footprint, no overturning
PANCAKE_IN_FOOTPRINT.look_for: Wide shots from two or more sides showing stacked slabs and debris extent

NO_TILT.desc: No tilt or rotation of the collapsed mass; debris confined to footprint and adjoining street
NO_TILT.look_for: Stack edges vertical; no rotated block; debris not thrown away from one side

TILTED_OR_OVERTURNED.desc: Collapsed mass tilted, rotated or overturned to one side
TILTED_OR_OVERTURNED.look_for: Block lying on its side; slabs inclined consistently; one side of the footprint sunk

NO_COLUMN_STUBS_BETWEEN_SLABS.desc: Slabs tightly stacked with no column stubs between: columns crushed or punched through over the full storey
NO_COLUMN_STUBS_BETWEEN_SLABS.look_for: Stack edge close-up; gaps between slabs; column remnants

DEBRIS_THROWN_FAR.desc: Debris projected far beyond the footprint, glass and fragments scattered radially
DEBRIS_THROWN_FAR.look_for: Debris field extent vs building height; radial pattern

SCORCH_OR_BLAST_MARKS.desc: Scorching, soot or blast damage on fragments or neighbours
SCORCH_OR_BLAST_MARKS.look_for: Blackened surfaces, melted plastics, outward-bowed neighbour openings

REBAR_MILL_MARKED.desc: Bars carry grade markings from recognised mills (grade claimed, not verified)
REBAR_MILL_MARKED.look_for: Rolled-in markings on bars. Does NOT verify diameter, yield, ductility, or rule out counterfeit/re-rolled bars

REBAR_UNDERSIZED_OR_SMOOTH.desc: Main bars undersized for the member, or smooth/re-rolled bars in primary members
REBAR_UNDERSIZED_OR_SMOOTH.look_for: Bar diameter against a tape or caliper; deformations; marking absent

REBAR_CORRODED.desc: Significant corrosion or section loss on bars
REBAR_CORRODED.look_for: Flaky rust, pitting, reduced section at fracture

POSSIBLE_HONEYCOMBING.desc: Open-textured, voided concrete fragment: possible honeycombing (unverified)
POSSIBLE_HONEYCOMBING.look_for: Fresh fracture faces of columns/slabs; voids, poor compaction, segregated aggregate

POOR_CONCRETE_CONFIRMED.desc: Friable concrete that crumbles by hand, weak aggregate, or low core/rebound results
POOR_CONCRETE_CONFIRMED.look_for: Fracture faces; hand-crushing; rebound hammer or cores

SPARSE_TIES_90_HOOKS.desc: Column ties widely spaced (> ~200 mm) and/or 90-degree hooks that opened
SPARSE_TIES_90_HOOKS.look_for: Column stub close-ups with tape: tie spacing, hook angle, opened ties

LAPS_AT_ONE_LEVEL.desc: All column bars lapped at the same level, short laps
LAPS_AT_ONE_LEVEL.look_for: Column stub at floor level: bar ends, lap length vs bar diameter

SMALL_COLUMNS_FOR_HEIGHT.desc: Ground-storey columns small for the number of storeys
SMALL_COLUMNS_FOR_HEIGHT.look_for: Column dimensions with tape; storey count

CUT_OR_REMOVED_GROUND_ELEMENTS.desc: Ground-storey columns or walls cut, chased or removed (shopfronts, openings)
CUT_OR_REMOVED_GROUND_ELEMENTS.look_for: Saw cuts, chased services, missing columns, fresh openings at L0

RIBBED_EPS_SLABS.desc: Ribbed slabs with lightweight void formers (EPS)
RIBBED_EPS_SLABS.look_for: White void formers in slab edges

ACTIVE_CONSTRUCTION_PROPS.desc: Timber or steel props throughout the debris: active construction with propped slabs
ACTIVE_CONSTRUCTION_PROPS.look_for: Props, formwork, fresh concrete in upper debris

UPPER_FLOORS_RECENT.desc: Upper floors visibly newer (different materials, unfinished) than lower floors
UPPER_FLOORS_RECENT.look_for: Pre-collapse photos or debris showing new storeys on an older frame

NEIGHBOUR_DAMAGED_TO_HEIGHT.desc: Neighbour damaged up to its roof: collapsed building at least as tall
NEIGHBOUR_DAMAGED_TO_HEIGHT.look_for: Impact damage on adjoining facades and roof edges

ADJACENT_EXCAVATION.desc: Recent excavation, basement or trench next to the footprint

SETTLEMENT_OR_HEAVE.desc: Ground cracking, heave, ponding or settled footings at the site
SETTLEMENT_OR_HEAVE.look_for: Ground surface around footprint; exposed footings

VOIDS_UNDER_STACK.desc: Survivable voids beneath or within the stack
VOIDS_UNDER_STACK.look_for: Openings at the base of the pile

RECORD_CRACKS_REPORTED.desc: Cracks or distress reported before the collapse

RECORD_OCCUPIED_NO_CERT.desc: Occupied while construction continued; no occupation certificate
